id: -362-斯巴達對維奧蒂亞聯盟的第二次起義
theater: 留克特拉平原與曼提尼亞

battle.name: 斯巴達對維奧蒂亞聯盟的第二次起義
battle.theater: 留克特拉平原與曼提尼亞
battle.brief: 前三七一至三六二年，斯巴達與底比斯主導的維奧蒂亞聯盟為伯羅奔尼撒霸權而戰。留克特拉一役，斯巴達方陣敗於底比斯的斜陣；卡面的亞述長弓屬前七〇〇年前後的複合反曲弓譜系，與戰役中為數不多的希臘弓手同源，真正決定勝負的仍是重裝步兵的矛與盾。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在公元前四世紀後半的希臘本土，性質是城邦聯盟之間的霸權爭奪：斯巴達拒絕交出它在伯羅奔尼撒的霸權，因此被後世記作「對維奧蒂亞聯盟的第二次起義」。交戰一方是斯巴達城邦及其附屬體系，作戰主力是由斯巴達公民組成的重裝步兵方陣，外圍有拉科尼亞與美塞尼亞的庇里埃科人步兵、由依附斯巴達的美塞尼亞黑勞人口編成的輔兵，以及規模不大的斯巴達騎兵。斯巴達的指揮體系是古老的雙王制加三十人長老會與五名監察官，作戰時仍倚賴分遣隊的統率制度，並且必須同時應付軍內「基納冬之友」那樣的密謀集團。另一方是維奧蒂亞聯盟，即以底比斯為盟主的底比斯聯邦：底比斯人自居聯盟之首，聯盟之內有底比斯、塔納格拉、提斯匹亞、哈利特斯等維奧蒂亞城邦的團隊，外加聯盟盟軍、福基斯人、阿爾戈斯人、以梅加洛波利斯為中心的阿卡迪亞聯盟各城邦、由費雷城傑森提供的帖薩利騎兵，以及雅典人與美塞尼亞流亡者組成的復國軍。聯盟一方沒有斯巴達式的常備公民兵，而是以聯邦議會與盟軍名冊維持軍隊，重裝步兵、輕裝步兵與騎兵分屬不同編制，按會期調集。整場衝突因此也是兩套軍制的較量：一方靠公民常備軍與個人戰技維持霸權，另一方靠聯邦制度集中兵力，最終兩者的聯盟都解體，底比斯的霸權在曼提尼亞之後瓦解，阿卡迪亞聯盟也在戰後的混亂中分裂。
countriesEn: This war was fought in the later fourth century BC on the Greek mainland, and its nature was a struggle between two city-state alliances for the hegemony of the Peloponnese: Sparta refused to surrender that hegemony, and for this reason the episode was later recorded as the second revolt of Sparta against the Boeotian League. One side was the Spartan state and its dependent system. The fighting core was the phalanx of Spartan citizens, ringed round by the hoplites of the perioikoi of Laconia and Messenia, by auxiliaries drawn from the Messenian helot population that had attached itself to Sparta, and by a Spartan cavalry of small numbers. The command system was the ancient dual kingship together with the council of thirty and the five ephors; in the field it still relied on the dispatch of separate detachments, and at the same time it had to contend with conspiratorial groups inside the Spartan body such as the Friends of Cinadon. The other side was the Boeotian League, the Boeotian federation headed by Thebes. The Thebans stood at the head of it: inside the league were the contingents of the Boeotian cities of Thebes, Tanagra, Thespiae, Haliartus and the rest, joined by the federal levies, the Phocians, the Argives, the cities of the Arcadian League centred on Megalopolis, the Thessalian cavalry supplied by Jason of Pherae, and a restoration army of Athenian troops and Messenian exiles. The league side had no standing citizen army of the Spartan kind: it kept its forces through a federal council and through muster rolls, with heavy infantry, light infantry and cavalry held in separate establishments and drawn up according to the sessions of the league. The whole conflict was therefore also a trial between two military systems, one resting on a citizen standing army and on the individual skills of its men, the other on a federal structure able to concentrate troops, and in the end both federations came apart, Theban hegemony collapsing after Mantinea and the Arcadian League splitting apart in the confusion that followed.
people: 底比斯方面的核心人物是埃帕米農達斯，這場戰爭的戰術與戰局大半由他一人定奪。他是底比斯的將軍與政治家，久任底比斯聯盟的波奧比亞德，據說在底比斯城郊的私人莊園授徒，亞歷山大大帝少年時寄居底比斯的隨行者帕爾梅尼翁即曾受其教誨；他把斜陣用於留克特拉，又四次引兵入伯羅奔尼撒，是聯盟軍隊的實際指揮核心。他的同僚佩洛皮達斯以神聖連隊的指揮者著稱，前三七〇年末率聯盟軍突入拉科尼亞、直逼斯巴達城下，雖未攻破那座沒有城防的城，卻完成了對城區的直接掠奪，此役後在救援哈利特斯的作戰中陣亡。斯巴達方面的關鍵人物是國王克里奧姆布羅圖斯一世，他於前三七一年率軍北上是為了阻止阿卡迪亞聯盟的籌備會議與聯盟軍的集結，留克特拉一戰中陣亡，斯巴達的霸權也隨之崩解；名將呂山德作為他的顧問在場，此後出使海上，試圖以波斯的金錢重新武裝斯巴達，最終在救援哈利特斯時陣亡。另一位國王阿基達莫斯二世在戰敗後被元老院放逐到梯吉亞，退居海外並在海外身亡。前三六一年返國復位的是阿革西勞斯二世，他以長期在亞洲統率希臘傭兵著稱；其子阿基達莫斯三世在帖薩利與福基斯人一同作戰時陣亡。聯盟與友軍方面還有費雷的傑森，他以帖薩利騎兵支援留克特拉，是聯盟方最關鍵的騎兵來源；美塞尼亞的阿里斯托美涅斯率流亡者與黑勞返鄉重建邦國，是斯巴達在南部領土崩解的直接推手。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Theban side was Epaminondas, and the tactics and the course of this war were for the most part settled by him alone. He was a general and a statesman of Thebes, long held the office of Boeotarch of the Boeotian League, and was said to teach at a private estate outside the walls of the city; Parmenion, who attended Alexander the Great as a companion while the boy stayed at Thebes, is counted among those instructed by him. He applied the oblique order at Leuctra and led armies into the Peloponnese four times, and he was the working command core of the league's forces. His colleague Pelopidas was known as the commander of the Sacred Band; in the winter of 370 BC he led the league army into Laconia and up to the gates of Sparta, and although he could not take the undefended city itself he completed a direct plunder of the urban area, and he was killed later while relieving Haliartus. The decisive man on the Spartan side was the king Cleombrotus I, who marched north in 371 BC in order to break up the preparatory meetings of the Arcadian League and the mustering of its army, and who was killed at Leuctra, taking Spartan hegemony down with him; the general Lysander was present as his adviser, and afterwards travelled to the sea powers in an attempt to rearm Sparta with Persian money, ending his life while relieving Haliartus. The other king, Archidamus II, was banished by the ephors to Tegea after the defeat and spent the rest of his life abroad. The king who returned in 361 BC and resumed the kingship was Agesilaus II, long famous for commanding Greek mercenaries in Asia; his son Archidamus III was killed while fighting in Thessaly alongside the Phocians. On the side of the league and its allies stands Jason of Pherae, who supported Leuctra with the Thessalian cavalry and was the decisive source of mounted troops for the league; and Aristomenes of Messenia, who led exiles and helots home to rebuild his city-state, was the direct agent of the collapse of Sparta's southern territory.
kits: 卡面兵器是「亞述長弓」：亞述王國在公元前八至七世紀以弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域的代表性武器，弓身短而彎度大，複合結構並以角與肌腱加固，亞述浮雕中常見射手站在戰車車台上拉弓，車兵則靠弓兵開路。這件武器比本場戰爭早了千餘年，並沒有出現在留克特拉的戰場上；把它放進這場戰爭，是因為它標示出希臘世界在公元前四世紀仍然承襲的那一個技術譜系，即複合反曲弓。弓箭於公元前七至五世紀經西伯利亞與波斯傳入希臘，希臘的弓手所用的正是這類短型複合弓，力量不及亞述弓，但便於配箭、便於騎射與散射；不過在留克特拉與曼提尼亞這類重裝步兵會戰裡，弓箭手只擔任騷擾、掩護與追擊殘敵的配角，決定勝負的仍是持矛持盾的重裝步兵。實際的裝備編制大致如下：聯盟軍以底比斯重裝步兵為核心，配圓盾、長矛、青銅或皮革胸甲、青銅頭盔與脛甲，側翼編入約三千名輕裝步兵，以短矛與投槍作戰，另有弓手與投石手；斯巴達方面是同樣的希臘重裝步兵裝備，加上人數不多的騎兵與外邦傭兵，其作戰幾乎不倚重弓箭。攻城方面，埃帕米農達斯在斯巴達城下使用過攻城塔、撞柱與巨型攻城砲，並曾以砲火射擊城內建築；運輸上，聯盟軍靠輜重車隊與就地徵發維持糧秣，斯巴達的糧道最短，卻因失去美塞尼亞的耕地與黑勞而難以為繼。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Assyrian bow: the signature arm with which the Assyrian kingdom combined bow and iron to conquer the river plains of Mesopotamia in the eighth and seventh centuries BC. Its bow is short and deeply curved, of composite construction, reinforced with horn and sinew, and Assyrian reliefs repeatedly show archers shooting from the platforms of war chariots, the charioteers relying on the archers to open the way. This weapon predates the present war by more than a millennium and never appeared on the battlefield of Leuctra; it is set in this war because it marks the one technological family that the Greek world of the fourth century BC still inherited, the composite recurve bow. Bows had reached Greece through Scythia and Persia in the seventh and fifth centuries BC, and the Greek archers used exactly this sort of short composite bow, weaker than the Assyrian one but easy to shoot, easy to handle on horseback and easy to mass in loose order. Even so, in set-piece battles of heavy infantry such as Leuctra and Mantinea, the archers were supporting players only, harrying, covering and pursuing the broken; what decided the day was still the heavy infantry with its spear and shield. The actual order of equipment ran roughly as follows. The league army was built around Theban heavy infantry with round shields, long spears, bronze or leather cuirasses, bronze helmets and greaves, with about three thousand light infantry in the flanks fighting with short spears and javelins, together with archers and slingers. The Spartans fielded the same Hellenic heavy infantry equipment, added a small number of cavalry and some foreign mercenaries, and relied hardly at all on archery. On the siege side Epaminondas used siege towers, battering rams and huge artillery pieces against the walls of Sparta, and at one point fired projectiles at the buildings inside the town. In the matter of transport the league armies kept their supplies moving with baggage trains and requisition on the spot, while Sparta had the shortest lines of supply of anyone and yet could not sustain them once the Messenian lands and helots were lost.
tactics: 留克特拉的取勝辦法是斜陣。埃帕米農達斯沒有讓全線同時進攻，而是把主力疊在左翼：左翼縱隊一路排到數十排深，靠斯庫羅洛斯山脊居高臨下，正面只以少量縱隊佯動，把斯巴達全軍最擅長的右翼衝鋒引向自己；右翼則故意退讓，並由輕裝步兵與投射兵覆蓋，不讓斯巴達的輕兵騷擾左翼深陣的側背，己方騎兵同時在右翼掃清對手騎兵，使斯巴達的陣線無法向中軍壓上。斯巴達方仍照希臘通例以右翼最精銳的公民兵打主攻，陣線一被拖入坡地與縱隊間的缺口便無法展開人數優勢，被拉成十字形與楔形的縱隊遭逐段突破，中軍在混戰中被底比斯精銳壓垮。戰後聯盟軍沿用同一套原理：前三七〇年末，聯盟軍取道阿拉奧尼亞山脈與奧伊諾斯河谷，晝夜兼程繞開斯巴達的正面防線，先取塞拉西亞，再沿歐羅塔斯河谷直抵斯巴達城下；因居民多已撤走，聯盟軍得以縱火掠奪城區、拆毀海岸的防禦工事、奪取鑄幣作坊與兵器庫，卻不敢久留，因聯盟內部對是否攻陷斯巴達意見分歧。曼提尼亞一役是同一套斜陣的最後一次發作：埃帕米農達斯再次以左翼深陣突破聯盟右翼，試圖用騎兵與包抄製造全殲，卻因右翼遭到斯巴達與阿卡迪亞騎兵的反擊而被打散，他本人被標槍刺中胸部當場陣亡，包抄未能完成。整體而言，聯盟的戰術核心是集中優勢兵力於一翼、拒絕另一翼，並配合輕裝步兵與騎兵的遮蔽與追擊；斯巴達則死守右翼衝鋒與方陣正面對決的舊準則，這正是它覆敗的技術原因。
tacticsEn: The way Leuctra was won was the oblique order. Epaminondas did not attack along the whole front at once: he massed his strength on the left, running the files of his left wing back many ranks deep, covering the ground above the ridge of Skolos, and showing only a token formation on the front so as to draw the Spartan right, the arm the Spartan army handled best, against himself. His right was deliberately refused, screened by light infantry and missile troops so that Spartan light troops could not work round the flank of the deep left, while his own cavalry on that wing swept the opposing horse off the field and kept the Spartan line from pressing on the centre. The Spartans still fought according to the Hellenic custom, striking with the best of their citizens on the right; once that line was dragged into broken ground and into the gaps between the deep files it could no longer spread its numbers to advantage, its files were broken through section by section in cross and wedge formation, and the centre collapsed in the melee under the Theban foot. The league army afterwards worked on the same principle. In the winter of 370 BC it took the road over the Aroanian mountains and through the valley of the Oinous, marched day and night to turn the Spartan's frontal defence, seized Sellasia first and then came down the Eurotas valley to the walls of Sparta itself. The town had largely been emptied, so the league army was able to put it to the torch and plunder it, to break up the defensive works along the coast and to carry off the mint and the arsenal; it did not dare stay long, because inside the league there was disagreement over whether Sparta should be taken and occupied. Mantinea was the last working of the same oblique order: Epaminondas again broke the opposing right with a deep left and tried to produce an annihilation by cavalry and envelopment, but the right was broken up by a counter-stroke from Spartan and Arcadian horse, and he himself was struck in the chest by a javelin and fell on the field, so that the envelopment never closed. In general the tactical heart of the league was to concentrate the superior force on one wing, refuse the other, and to use light infantry and cavalry for screening and pursuit; Sparta held fast to the old canon of striking with the right and of settling matters by frontal collision of phalanxes, and that was the technical reason for its collapse.
data: 可核實的數字集中在留克特拉一戰。聯盟軍方面，塞諾芬記重裝步兵約六千人、輕裝步兵約一千人，另有帖薩利騎兵約五百，盟軍的輕裝步兵另約三千；波利比奧斯則記底比斯方面的步兵總數為六千。斯巴達方面的重裝步兵約六千人，其中斯巴達公民約一千，其餘為庇里埃科人與美塞尼亞黑勞編成的盟兵，騎兵數百。兩軍相加，交戰兵力在萬餘量級，這在希臘城邦戰爭中已是罕見。傷亡記載互相矛盾：狄奧多羅斯記斯巴達軍陣亡約一千人、其輕步兵再折約二千，底比斯軍僅折約三百；另有說法把底比斯的損失提到近一千，把斯巴達的損失壓到不足一千。可以確定的倒是斯巴達公民的損失比例極高，遠超斯巴達此後任何一場戰役。距離與時間：底比斯至留克特拉直線約六十公里，梯吉亞至斯巴達約五十公里，塞拉西亞在斯巴達城北約二十公里，阿卡迪亞聯盟的首都梅加洛波利斯距曼提尼亞約五十公里。戰爭自前三七〇年末聯盟軍突入拉科尼亞算起，到前三六二年曼提尼亞為止，前後約八年；若從前三七一年留克特拉算起則接近九年。斯巴達城內的密謀集團「基納冬之友」被破獲後，百餘名斯巴達人被處死。曼提尼亞一役的具體傷亡數字沒有留下可靠記載，只有兩軍皆重創的概括。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated at the battle of Leuctra. On the league side Xenophon gives about six thousand heavy infantry, about a thousand light infantry, some five hundred Thessalian cavalry and a further three thousand light infantry from the allies; Polybius gives the total of the Theban infantry as six thousand. The Spartan side had about six thousand heavy infantry, of whom some one thousand were Spartan citizens and the rest perioikoi and allies drawn from the Messenian helots, with some hundreds of cavalry. Taken together the two armies numbered in the region of ten thousand men, which was already exceptional for a war between Greek city-states. The casualty accounts contradict one another: Diodorus records about a thousand dead among the Spartans and a further two thousand of their light infantry, with only about three hundred lost by the Thebans; other versions raise the Theban loss to nearly a thousand and push the Spartan loss below a thousand. What can be asserted is that the proportion of Spartan citizens killed was extremely high, higher than in any later Spartan battle. Distances and timings: the straight line from Thebes to Leuctra is about sixty kilometres, from Tegea to Sparta about fifty, Sellasia lies about twenty kilometres north of the city of Sparta, and Megalopolis, the capital of the Arcadian League, is about fifty kilometres from Mantinea. The war runs from the league army's entry into Laconia in the winter of 370 BC to the battle of Mantinea in 362 BC, some eight years in all; counted from Leuctra in 371 BC it is close to nine years. After the conspiracy of the Friends of Cinadon was uncovered inside Sparta, more than a hundred Spartans were executed. No reliable figures survive for the casualties at Mantinea itself, only the general statement that both armies were badly mauled.
cause: 起義的成因有三層。最上層是制度層：公元前四世紀上半葉的希臘，霸權原本握在斯巴達聯盟手裡，底比斯在留克特拉之前就已聯手阿爾戈斯、雅典與福基斯，試圖打破斯巴達的壟斷；留克特拉之後，維奧蒂亞聯盟與新生的阿卡迪亞聯盟同時出現，兩者都要求伯羅奔尼撒的城邦脫離斯巴達的指揮。阿卡迪亞聯盟的籌備尤其刺痛斯巴達，那是伯羅奔尼撒第一個以聯邦議會與共同軍隊為形式的聯盟，一旦成立，拉科尼亞與美塞尼亞的邊界國家都會被吸進去，斯巴達再也無力單獨決定半島的事。斯巴達的反應是把矛盾外部化：前三七一年，克里奧姆布羅圖斯一世以協助雅典對付底比斯為名率軍北上，進入阿提卡，企圖在阿卡迪亞聯盟開會之前先掃掉梯吉亞與梅加洛波利斯，切斷聯盟軍的集結，最終卻在留克特拉全軍覆沒。中層是人力與制度層：斯巴達的公民兵源枯竭，能上戰場的斯巴達人不到全軍的六分之一；黑勞人口大量外逃，美塞尼亞的黑勞在戰前就已在底比斯的煽動下人心浮動；長老會與國王之間的權力衝突捲入「基納冬之友」的政變陰謀，說明斯巴達的內部已無法承受連續挫敗。底層是經濟與地理層：斯巴達是一個沒有腹地、以控制整個伯羅奔尼撒維持霸權的城邦，號令一旦失效便沒有替代的生財之道；而底比斯控制科林斯地峽與通往伯羅奔尼撒的陸路，阿爾戈斯與梅加洛波利斯提供了跳板，費雷的傑森以財源與騎兵換取底比斯的支持。直接引爆點是留克特拉：斯巴達的北伐失敗，使聯盟軍第一次可以把軍隊開進拉科尼亞。
causeEn: The revolt has three layers of cause. The uppermost is institutional: in the first half of the fourth century BC the hegemony of the Greek world rested with the Spartan alliance, and long before Leuctra the Thebans had joined hands with Argos, Athens and Phocis in an attempt to break the Spartan monopoly. After Leuctra the Boeotian League and the newly formed Arcadian League appeared at the same time, and both demanded that the cities of the Peloponnese be released from Spartan command. The preparations for the Arcadian League stung Sparta in particular, for it was the first league in the Peloponnese to take the form of a federal council and a common army, and once it was founded the border communities of Laconia and Messenia would be drawn into it, leaving Sparta no longer able to decide the affairs of the peninsula by itself. Sparta's reaction was to externalise the quarrel: in 371 BC Cleombrotus I marched north under the pretext of helping Athens against Thebes, entered Attica, and tried to clear out Tegea and Megalopolis before the Arcadians met in council, so as to cut off the mustering of the league army; instead his army was annihilated at Leuctra. The middle layer concerns man-power and institutions: the supply of Spartan citizens had dried up, and fewer than one man in six under arms was a Spartan; helots were leaving in large numbers, and the Messenian helots were already unsettled by Theban agitation before the war began; the conflict between the council of elders and the kings was drawn into the conspiracy of the Friends of Cinadon, which shows that the Spartan body politic could no longer absorb a run of defeats. The lowest layer is economic and geographical: Sparta was a city with no hinterland of its own, which maintained its hegemony by commanding the whole Peloponnese, and once its orders ceased to be obeyed it had no alternative source of revenue; Thebes, meanwhile, held the Isthmus of Corinth and the land road into the Peloponnese, Argos and Megalopolis supplied the bridgeheads, and Jason of Pherae exchanged money and cavalry for Theban support. The immediate trigger was Leuctra: the failure of the Spartan northern campaign allowed the league army for the first time to march into Laconia.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的最深影響不在戰場，而在整套戰爭觀念。留克特拉之後，希臘世界再沒有人相信斯巴達軍團不可戰勝：此前三百年間被奉為圭臬的斯巴達例外不攻自破，斯巴達城邦在十年之內從伯羅奔尼撒的霸主變成需要仰人鼻息的小邦。戰術層面上，埃帕米農達斯的斜陣成為古典兵法的教科書範例，被後世反覆引述，也被馬其頓的腓力二世改造吸收，成為後來方陣戰術的一個源頭；與此同時，希臘的重裝步兵制度本身卻在崩解：伊法克拉忒斯於前三七四至三七一年間改造輕裝步兵的嘗試、底比斯與阿卡迪亞大量使用輕裝步兵與投射兵的做法，都說明純粹的公民重裝步兵已難以單獨決定戰局，弓箭、投槍與騎兵在戰場上的份量上升，卡面這件亞述長弓所代表的那一類投射兵器，正是這條演變線的遠祖。政治層面上，阿卡迪亞聯盟是伯羅奔尼撒第一個聯邦國家，它的議會制度、主席制與共同軍隊成為後來亞該亞同盟與亞托利亞同盟的樣本，讓希臘人第一次在城邦框架之外想像秩序。土地與人口層面上，美塞尼亞脫離斯巴達、黑勞獲得自由，南方邊界被永久改寫，斯巴達從此補不回失去的耕地與人口。更遠的後果是：底比斯的霸權在前三六二年曼提尼亞之後迅速崩落，希臘陷入多方混戰，最後由馬其頓在喀羅尼亞一役收場，伯羅奔尼撒聯盟被解散，整個南希臘再未恢復獨立的政治生活。
impactEn: The deepest effect this war left was not on the battlefield but on the whole conception of warfare. After Leuctra nobody in the Greek world any longer believed that a Spartan army could not be beaten: the Spartan exception, treated as a law of nature for three hundred years, collapsed of its own accord, and within ten years the Spartan city had changed from hegemon of the Peloponnese into a small state dependent on the favour of others. At the tactical level the oblique order of Epaminondas became the textbook model of the classical art of war, quoted again and again by later writers and absorbed and reshaped by Philip of Macedon, becoming one of the sources of phalanx warfare in the centuries after. At the same time the Hellenic system of heavy infantry was itself breaking up: the attempt of Iphicrates to re-equip the peltast between 374 and 371 BC, and the practice of Thebes and of Arcadia in making large use of light infantry and missile troops, both show that the pure citizen heavy infantry could no longer settle a battle by itself, and that the bow, the javelin and the horse were gaining weight on the field; the class of missile weapons represented by the Assyrian bow on this card is the remote ancestor of that line of change. At the political level the Arcadian League was the first federated state in the Peloponnese, and its council, its presidency and its common army served as a model for the Achaean and Aetolian leagues that came later, letting the Greeks for the first time imagine an order of things outside the frame of the city-state. At the level of land and population, the freeing of Messenia and of the helots permanently rewrote the southern frontier, and Sparta could never make good the land and the people it had lost. The longer consequence was this: Theban hegemony collapsed quickly after Mantinea in 362 BC, Greece fell into a general contest among many powers, and in the end Macedon closed the matter at Chaeronea, the Peloponnesian League was dissolved, and the whole of southern Greece never recovered an independent political life.
result: 前三七一年七月的留克特拉是全場的分水嶺：斯巴達的方陣被底比斯的深陣正面壓垮，克里奧姆布羅圖斯一世陣亡，斯巴達的不可戰勝在一天之內被推翻。前三七〇年末，聯盟軍在阿卡迪亞人配合下越過阿拉奧尼亞山脈，先取塞拉西亞，再進歐羅塔斯河谷，兵臨沒有城防的斯巴達，掠走城區財物、毀掉海岸工事與鑄幣作坊，把美塞尼亞的大部分土地交給流亡者；斯巴達的城邦聯盟就此瓦解，國王阿基達莫斯二世被放逐，呂山德在隨後的救援作戰中陣亡，斯巴達的海上帝國也隨之喪失。戰爭並未因斯巴達的崩潰而結束：聯盟在前三六八年的阿卡迪亞無淚之戰中被斯巴達逆轉，前三六六年圍攻斯巴達的行動因仲裁而中止，前三六四年佩洛皮達斯戰死在曼提尼亞附近，前三六二年曼提尼亞之役中埃帕米農達斯陣亡，底比斯的聯盟霸權就此終結，阿卡迪亞聯盟也隨之分裂，斯巴達在阿革西勞斯二世回國後得到喘息的機會，卻再也回不到從前。前三五七年起的社會戰讓維奧蒂亞聯盟與其前盟友互相殘殺，最終在前三五五至三五四年的王之和平裡收場；這場八年的戰爭留下的只有兩個殘破的聯盟，和一條被南方邊界與戰俘重新劃定的分界線。
resultEn: The battle of Leuctra in July 371 BC was the watershed of the whole war: the Spartan phalanx was crushed head-on by the deep formation of Thebes, Cleombrotus I was killed, and the claim that Sparta could not be defeated was overturned in a single day. In the winter of 370 BC the league army, with Arcadian support, crossed the Aroanian mountains, took Sellasia first and then entered the Eurotas valley, reaching the undefended city of Sparta, carrying off the wealth of the town, breaking up the works on the coast and the mint, and handing the greater part of Messenia to the exiles. The Spartan alliance of cities came apart there and then: the king Archidamus II was driven into exile, Lysander was killed in the relief operations that followed, and the Spartan maritime empire was lost with it. The war did not end with the collapse of Sparta. The league was reversed by Sparta in the tearless battle in Arcadia in 368 BC; the attempt to besiege Sparta in 366 BC was halted by arbitration; Pelopidas fell in action near Mantinea in 364 BC; and in the battle of Mantinea in 362 BC Epaminondas was killed, Theban league hegemony was thereby finished, the Arcadian League split apart, and Sparta was allowed a breathing space when Agesilaus II came home, though it never came back to what it had been. The Social War that began in 357 BC set the Boeotian League and its former allies tearing at one another, and the whole affair was wound up in the King's Peace of 355 and 354 BC. What the eight years of fighting left behind were two ruined alliances and a frontier line redrawn in the south by new boundaries and new captives.
